sentences.en: A satellite was launched into orbit to monitor melting glaciers.
sentences.zh: 一颗卫星被送入轨道以监测冰川融化。

sentences.en: Glaciers, land ice and icebergs are made of fresh water.
sentences.zh: 冰川、陆地冰和冰山都是由淡水构成的。

sentences.en: It is dangerous to walk on a calving glacier.

mnemonic: 词根记忆：glac（冰）+ier（表物）→冰川，冰河
